easy-song.title: Choose a song
body: Pick one of the bundled songs, or drop a track anywhere on the page.
Its passages, beats and drops land on the strip, and the desk moves on to Plan by itself.

easy-vibe.title: Pick a vibe
body: Choose a card: its objects land on the beats of the strip and the monitor sketches them, no GPU.
Type an idea in one line if you have one; the cut follows it.
With no song chosen, the bundled demo stands in.

easy-make.title: Render a Draft
body: Render Draft spends the GPU on 30 s around the drop, in a few minutes, with open weights on this machine.
Tweak the feel first if you like: a preset, the knobs and the look; re-cutting a Draft spends no GPU.
easy-make.sim: Simulated. No GPU job was started.

easy-strip.title: Inspect a shot
body: Click a shot or a seam on the strip: the inspector opens right under it.
On a plan it names the object the shot lands on; on a cut, the shot's look, its join and a re-roll.
Drag the Draft window along the song to cut another stretch.

easy-perform.title: Perform it
body: Perform plays a rendered cut live in its own window: pads hold a picture, the knobs ride the look, Rec records a take.
The step opens once a Draft is rendered.

tours.name: The desk in a minute
tours.blurb: A song, a vibe, a Draft, a shot on the strip, then Perform.
